newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - LS quiet, but slightly lon.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - LS quiet, but slightly lon.

text.p: The low sulphur straight-run fuel market was quiet on Friday, with the U.S Thanksgiving holiday contributing to the flat market.

One buyer was understood to be discreetly looking for a cargo in an attempt to cover for a West African cargo that is delayed over a week. But, traders said there were at least two cargoes on offers in early December and the potential buyer did not appear pressured. Prices were pegged around $142-144 fob NWE on the buy side and $146-147 on the sell side.
Russian high sulphur cargoes were still available with the situation concerning the long-expected export tariff no clearer.
